summary: Analog-style synth bass: punchy, house, synth-pop and synthwave
label: synth bass
body: Off-beat house bass, pumping 8ths in synthwave, octave disco lines. Hollower, 80s: openDAW/Square Bass; the General MIDI ones: GeneralUser GS/Synth Bass 1, darker Synth Bass 2, techno GeneralUser GS/Techno Bass.

Register: MIDI 28-48 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: openDAW/House Bass, openDAW's factory preset for Neon (a CZ-style phase-distortion synth): make_instrument (sound "openDAW/House Bass") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
